name: Demonic Power applies +180% threat and +230% Fire threat, as its spell description states (#228)
contract: Issue #228 reports that Demonic Power 807730's buff tooltip says Fire spells get an extra 230% threat while the spell description says an extra 50%. Live client Spell.dbc 807730: effect 0 is SPELL_AURA_MOD_THREAT with EffectBasePoints 179 + DieSides 1 = 180 and EffectMiscValue 123 (every school except Fire, mask 4); effect 2 is SPELL_AURA_MOD_THREAT with 229 + 1 = 230 and EffectMiscValue 4 (Fire only); effect 1 is an inert 0% SPELL_AURA_MOD_DAMAGE_PERCENT_TAKEN. The spell Description reads 'increasing your threat generated by $s1%, plus an additional ${$m3-$m1}% with Fire spells and abilities' (180, plus 230-180 = 50), while the aura ToolTip string reads 'Threat generated increased by ${$w1}%, plus an additional ${$w3}% with Fire spells and abilities', printing the whole Fire amount 230 as the 'additional' part. Both strings are client DBC text rendered by the client from these effect values; no server code or SQL changes 807730. ThreatManager::UpdateMySpellSchoolModifiers multiplies SPELL_AURA_MOD_THREAT per school through GetTotalAuraMultiplierByMiscMask, so with these masks non-Fire threat is x2.8 (+180%) and Fire threat x3.3 (+230% = 180% + 50%), exactly what the Description states; the ToolTip wording is the client-side mismatch. Expected: casting Demonic Power at its level 14 applies the aura with effect 0 amount 180 and effect 2 amount 230. The harness has no threat metric, so the per-school multipliers are derived from these amounts and the DBC masks.

steps.label: SETUP: the knight knows Demonic Power
Demonic Power is active on the knight
Threat from every non-Fire school is increased by 180%
Fire threat is increased by 230% in total, 50% more than the other schools
